DISMISSAL WITHOUT PREJUDICE OF COMPLAINT AS TO DEFENDANT DOES 1 TO 10, INCL.

CAUSE CALLED, THE COURT ORDERED THAT PLAINTIFF BANK OF THE WEST HAVE AND RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT AUTO CONNECTION SPECIALISTS, INC. DBA AUTOSIMPLE MANKO, RANDAL POSSESSION OF THE FOLLOWING DESCRIBED PROPERTY, TO WIT: ONE KEY MANAGEMENT SYSTEM, WHICH EQUIPMENT COLLECTIVELY HAS A FAIR MARKET VALUE OF $2,000.00, OR IN CASE A DELIVERY OF SAID PROPERTY TO PLAINTIFF CANNOT BE HAD, THEN THAT THE PLAINTIFF HAVE AND RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT $11,832.03 DAMAGES, $1,525.00 ATTORNEY FEES, $375.00 COSTS, $531.36 INTEREST, TOTAL JUDGMENT $14,263.39, AND IS ENTITLED TO ITS IMMEDIATE POSSESSION, AND THAT PLAINTIFF HAVE AND RECOVER SAID PROPERTY FROM DEFENDANTS. IN EVENT PLAINTIFF, BANK OF THE WEST, OBTAINS POSSESSION OF AND SELLS SAID PERSONAL PROPERTY HEREAFTER, DEFENDANTS SHALL RECEIVE ALL CREDITS TO WHICH THEY ARE ENTITLED BY LAW.
ABSTRACT OF JUDGMENT ISSUED TO PLAINTIFF BANK OF THE WEST
PRE-TRIAL CALENDAR SWEEP, CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE CALENDAR OF JAN-30-2009, OFF CALENDAR, DISMISSAL OR JUDGMENT ON FILE AS TO ALL DEFENDANTS
